page.content:
Once-a-century firebending surge that started and could end the war.

How Sozin's Comet connects

  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The series races toward Sozin's Comet.
  • Character: Sozin — Sozin used the comet to destroy the Air Nomads.
  • Character: Ozai — Ozai plans to burn the Earth Kingdom under the comet.
  • Faction: Air Nomads — The comet attack is what ended the Air Nomads as a people.
  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The series climax is timed to Sozin's Comet.

What is Sozin's Comet?

Sozin's Comet is the celestial event that let Sozin destroy the Air Nomads and, a hundred years later, gives Ozai the power Aang must meet.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender (series), Sozin, Ozai, Air Nomads and Avatar: The Last Airbender (series).
